dad-1-1.where: Dad calls back after the page

dad-1-2.where: Dad calls back after the page

dad-1-3.where: Dad calls back after the page
dad-1-3.text: I was up to my elbows in a busted boiler across town, and I had to go find a pay phone!

dad-1-4.where: Dad calls back after the page

dad-1-5.where: Dad calls back after the page

dad-2-1.where: Dad calls back after the page

dad-2-2.where: Dad calls back after the page
dad-2-2.text: Then why are you paging me?

dad-2-3.where: Dad calls back after the page
dad-2-3.text: The pager is for EMERGENCIES ONLY.

dad-2-4.where: Dad calls back after the page
dad-2-4.text: We are going to have a long talk when I get home.

dad-2-5.where: Dad calls back after the page

giant-away-1.text: Our live game counselors are not available at this time.

giant-away-2.text: Please use our automated hint system, which is open all day and all night.

giant-bad-key-1.text: I do not know that button yet.

giant-bill-tail-1.text: Gwinn has offered to pay in lint.

giant-bill-tail-2.text: The telephone company is considering it.

giant-blaster-1-2.text: The twin guns fire whenever the Blaster moves, so just steer under the virus.

giant-blaster-2-2.text: The arrow pointing back only brakes, so dodge sideways.

giant-blaster-3-1.text: Save the Nova Bombs for bosses, and fire from right under the target.

giant-blaster-3-2.text: Press F2 to see your energy.

giant-brief-1-1.where: Hint line: Keep It Brief, hint 1
giant-brief-1-1.text: If THE END will not open, press F2.

giant-brief-1-2.where: Hint line: Keep It Brief, hint 1
giant-brief-1-2.text: It counts the words you carry, and every book has exactly one hundred.

giant-brief-2-1.where: Hint line: Keep It Brief, hint 2
giant-brief-2-1.text: THE END opened, but nothing happened?

giant-brief-2-2.where: Hint line: Keep It Brief, hint 2
giant-brief-2-2.text: Walk onto the open page, then onto the gold bookmark right behind it.

giant-brief-3-1.where: Hint line: Keep It Brief, hint 3
giant-brief-3-1.text: Brass bars on a door mean that wing belongs to a later chapter.

giant-brief-3-2.where: Hint line: Keep It Brief, hint 3
giant-brief-3-2.text: Finish your chapter first, then visit the Reserve Stacks.

giant-brief-intro.where: Hint line: Keep It Brief, welcome

giant-bye-1.where: Hint line: press 0 at the game menu

giant-bye-2.where: Hint line: press 0 at the game menu
giant-bye-2.text: Come back when you are stuck again.

giant-bye-3.where: Hint line: press 0 at the game menu

giant-depth-1-1.text: Amber blocks are the near plane.

giant-depth-1-2.text: Roll onto a focus ring with a cyan lens, and the far plane comes into focus.

giant-depth-2-2.text: Every focus ring works both ways.

giant-depth-2-3.text: Step off it and back on to pull focus again.

giant-depth-3-1.text: Pulling focus puts the scene back the way it was.

giant-depth-3-2.text: Photons and bulbs come back, but your lenses stay in your pocket.

giant-hello-1.text: Hello, and thank you for calling Teddy’s Hint Kennel!

giant-hello-2.text: I am the Hint Giant, and I talk nice and slow so nobody misses a thing.

giant-last-1.where: Hint line: after the last hint

giant-last-2.where: Hint line: after the last hint
giant-last-2.text: Press 2 for the game menu, or 0 to hear it again.

giant-logic-1-1.where: Hint line: Ohm Sweet Ohm, hint 1
giant-logic-1-1.text: Bump a switch from below to turn it on.

giant-logic-1-2.where: Hint line: Ohm Sweet Ohm, hint 1
giant-logic-1-2.text: Current runs along the wire to the gate, so keep off the wire while it glows.

giant-logic-2-1.where: Hint line: Ohm Sweet Ohm, hint 2
giant-logic-2-1.text: A gate stays open once current has reached it.

giant-logic-2-2.where: Hint line: Ohm Sweet Ohm, hint 2
giant-logic-2-2.text: Turn the power off again, wait for the last spark to drain away, then walk through.

giant-logic-3-1.where: Hint line: Ohm Sweet Ohm, hint 3
giant-logic-3-1.text: An arrow is a diode, and you can only go through it the way it points.

giant-logic-3-2.where: Hint line: Ohm Sweet Ohm, hint 3
giant-logic-3-2.text: Turn the switch on, wait for the gate to open, then turn the switch off again before you roll through.

giant-logic-intro.where: Hint line: Ohm Sweet Ohm, welcome

giant-maximus-1-1.where: Hint line: Maximus, the Hundred Worlds, hint 1
giant-maximus-1-1.text: To leave the training deck, pay the credit door, ride the lift, and get through the clearance gate in the pod bay.

giant-maximus-1-2.where: Hint line: Maximus, the Hundred Worlds, hint 1

giant-maximus-2.where: Hint line: Maximus, the Hundred Worlds, hint 2
giant-maximus-2.text: To land on a planet, fly the pod into the middle of the planet on the sector chart.

giant-maximus-3-1.where: Hint line: Maximus, the Hundred Worlds, hint 3
giant-maximus-3-1.text: To get back to space, walk into the uplink beacon behind you where you landed.

giant-maximus-3-2.where: Hint line: Maximus, the Hundred Worlds, hint 3
giant-maximus-3-2.text: On sea worlds, surface at the buoy.

giant-maximus-intro.where: Hint line: Maximus, the Hundred Worlds, welcome
giant-maximus-intro.text: Hints for Maximus, the Hundred Worlds.

giant-menu-1-10.text: For my pretend phone bill, press pound.

giant-menu-1-4.text: For Maximus, the Hundred Worlds, press 4.

giant-menu-1-6.text: For Quest for the Round Tuit, press 6.

giant-menu-2-1.text: For Teddy’s Little Big Adventure, press 1.

giant-menu-2-2.text: For Teddy’s Little Bigger Adventure, press 2.

giant-menu-2-3.text: For Teddy’s Little Biggest Adventure, press 3.

giant-menu-2-7.text: To go back to the first games, press 9.

giant-next.text: Press 1 for the next hint, 2 for the game menu, or 0 to hear it again.

giant-rate-1.text: This game charges a fictional $1.99 per minute, never real money.

giant-rate-2.text: Each minute is billed in full the moment it begins.

giant-rate-3.text: Press 1 to start the meter, or 0 to leave free.

giant-realm-1-1.where: Hint line: Quest for the Round Tuit, hint 1
giant-realm-1-1.text: Go first north up the road from Nowish to Laterburg.

giant-realm-1-2.where: Hint line: Quest for the Round Tuit, hint 1
giant-realm-1-2.text: Walk into the King on his throne to get the Royal Writ.

giant-realm-2-1.where: Hint line: Quest for the Round Tuit, hint 2
giant-realm-2-1.text: To talk to people, walk into them.

giant-realm-2-2.where: Hint line: Quest for the Round Tuit, hint 2
giant-realm-2-2.text: To buy things, walk into the counter once to pay, and again to take it.

giant-realm-3-1.where: Hint line: Quest for the Round Tuit, hint 3

giant-realm-3-2.where: Hint line: Quest for the Round Tuit, hint 3
giant-realm-3-2.text: Foes drop gems, and the dungeons have chests.

giant-realm-intro.where: Hint line: Quest for the Round Tuit, welcome
giant-realm-intro.text: Hints for Quest for the Round Tuit.

giant-sandcast-1-1.text: The shovel is beside Teddy’s toy chest in the southwest corner.

giant-sandcast-1-2.text: Press G to pick it up.

giant-sandcast-2-1.text: To get into Anthill Keep, dig through the ring of dunes with the shovel.

giant-sandcast-2-2.text: Two bites and a dune is gone.

giant-sandcast-3-1.text: Gwinn will move for the tennis ball.

giant-sandcast-3-2.text: Walk toward her and press F, and she trots off happy to bury it.

giant-sleuth-1-1.text: Start at the box office, off the west side of the lobby.

giant-sleuth-1-2.text: There is a key on the floor and a seating chart on the desk.

giant-sleuth-2-2.text: The key from the box office opens it, so walk into the door.

giant-sleuth-3-1.text: To get backstage, take the west aisle to the front.

giant-sleuth-3-2.text: Then go up through the pass door at stage left.

giant-snowbound-1.text: Press F2 to tip out the coffee can and see how much money you have.

giant-snowbound-2-2.text: Go back out to the mall lot.

giant-snowbound-2-3.text: A squall buries it again every twenty seconds or so, and that means more scoops and more dollars.

giant-snowbound-3-1.text: There is a five dollar tip in an envelope beside Mrs.

giant-teddy-1-1.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Big Adventure, hint 1

giant-teddy-1-2.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Big Adventure, hint 1
giant-teddy-1-2.text: Bring it to Pockets at Doc Leo’s little red car at the end of the stop.

giant-teddy-1-3.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Big Adventure, hint 1

giant-teddy-2-1.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Big Adventure, hint 2
giant-teddy-2-1.text: The floating balloon dogs are up high and never on the way.

giant-teddy-2-2.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Big Adventure, hint 2
giant-teddy-2-2.text: There are three in every stop, so take the detour.

giant-teddy-3-1.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Big Adventure, hint 3
giant-teddy-3-1.text: Gwinn running laps with a green ball?

giant-teddy-3-2.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Big Adventure, hint 3
giant-teddy-3-2.text: Face her and press Space as she zooms by.

giant-teddy-intro.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Big Adventure, welcome
giant-teddy-intro.text: Hints for Teddy’s Little Big Adventure.

giant-teddy2-1-1.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Bigger Adventure, hint 1
giant-teddy2-1-1.text: That faint wispy thing in the air is a scent.

giant-teddy2-1-2.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Bigger Adventure, hint 1
giant-teddy2-1-2.text: Stand next to it and press S to sniff.

giant-teddy2-2-1.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Bigger Adventure, hint 2

giant-teddy2-2-2.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Bigger Adventure, hint 2
giant-teddy2-2-2.text: Bring it to Doc Leo at THE CHEZ at the end of the stop.

giant-teddy2-2-3.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Bigger Adventure, hint 2

giant-teddy2-3-1.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Bigger Adventure, hint 3
giant-teddy2-3-1.text: Gwinn’s collar went down the laundry chute.

giant-teddy2-3-2.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Bigger Adventure, hint 3
giant-teddy2-3-2.text: Drop through the hole in the laundry room floor, then sniff in the basement.

giant-teddy2-intro.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Bigger Adventure, welcome
giant-teddy2-intro.text: Hints for Teddy’s Little Bigger Adventure.

giant-teddy3-1-1.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Biggest Adventure, hint 1
giant-teddy3-1-1.text: The card before each stop says who you are playing.

giant-teddy3-1-2.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Biggest Adventure, hint 1
giant-teddy3-1-2.text: Teddy runs the errands, and on the road you drive THE CHEZ.

giant-teddy3-2-1.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Biggest Adventure, hint 2
giant-teddy3-2-1.text: If a button does nothing, high five it from just beside it, facing it.

giant-teddy3-2-2.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Biggest Adventure, hint 2
giant-teddy3-2-2.text: Then watch the spark run down the wire.

giant-teddy3-3-1.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Biggest Adventure, hint 3
giant-teddy3-3-1.text: The keys are in the blue cabinet on the workbench.

giant-teddy3-3-2.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Biggest Adventure, hint 3
giant-teddy3-3-2.text: Hop onto the bench and high five the button on the wall above it.

giant-teddy3-intro.where: Hint line: Teddy’s Little Biggest Adventure, welcome
giant-teddy3-intro.text: Hints for Teddy’s Little Biggest Adventure.

giant-tuneup-1-1.text: Each door waits for something: a clamp, a pluck, enough notes, or every oiled Squeak.

giant-tuneup-1-2.text: Press F2 to see what you have.

giant-tuneup-2-1.text: To skip a cartoon, press a key.

giant-tuneup-2-2.text: The next key gets you to the level.

giant-tuneup-3-1.text: If the crank will not turn, stand right under it and hold Space.

giant-year2000-1-1.where: Hint line: In the Year 2000, hint 1
giant-year2000-1-1.text: The Laser-Tag Zapper is in your own backyard, north of the garage wall.

giant-year2000-1-2.where: Hint line: In the Year 2000, hint 1
giant-year2000-1-2.text: The clicker on Grandpa’s key ring opens the gate first.

giant-year2000-2-1.where: Hint line: In the Year 2000, hint 2
giant-year2000-2-1.text: Grandpa’s keys are in the hedge garden at the bottom left of the neighborhood.

giant-year2000-2-2.where: Hint line: In the Year 2000, hint 2

giant-year2000-3-1.where: Hint line: In the Year 2000, hint 3
giant-year2000-3-1.text: The hoverboard kids zoom up and down the roads.

giant-year2000-3-2.where: Hint line: In the Year 2000, hint 3
giant-year2000-3-2.text: Look both ways, and cross behind them.

giant-year2000-intro.where: Hint line: In the Year 2000, welcome

grandma-1-6.text: Grandma was out filling the bird feeder, I nearly didn’t hear it ring!

grandma-2-4.text: He knocked the African violet off the windowsill again.

grandma-2-5.text: Okay, bye-bye now, I love you!

gus-3.text: Nah, he’s out on a job across town, fixing somebody’s boiler.

jenny-3.text: I can’t talk, I’m on the other line.

jenny-4.text: Is your mom paying me Friday?

linda-1.text: Good afternoon, Three Rivers Insurance, this is Linda.

linda-2.text: How may I direct your call? …

machine-henderson-1.text: Hello, you have reached the Hendersons.

machine-henderson-2.text: Please leave your name, number, and the time you called, and we will get back to you.

machine-kowalski-3.text: We can’t come to the phone right now, so leave a message after the beep!

machine-rick-2.text: I’m not here, or maybe I am and I’m screening.

mom-work-1.where: Mom’s work: Mom, after the hold music

mom-work-2.where: Mom’s work: Mom, after the hold music

mom-work-3.where: Mom’s work: Mom, after the hold music

mom-work-4.where: Mom’s work: Mom, after the hold music
mom-work-4.text: Then why are you calling me at work?

mom-work-5.where: Mom’s work: Mom, after the hold music
mom-work-5.text: Do your homework, and don’t touch the stove.

mom-work-6.where: Mom’s work: Mom, after the hold music

movies-bye.text: Thank you for calling the Movie Line!

movies-hello-2.text: And welcome to the Movie Line!

movies-hello-3.text: Now showing at the Starlite Cinema 8.

movies-what.text: Why don’t you just tell me the name of the movie you’ve selected?

nine-one-one.text: Nine one one, what is your emergency?

nine-one-one-fire-2.text: We’re getting calls about a house fire on your street right now.

nine-one-one-fire-3.text: A truck is on the way.

nine-one-one-fire-4.text: Stay inside, and please, only call nine one one for a real emergency.

not-in-service-2.text: The number you have reached is not in service.

not-in-service-3.text: Please check the number and dial again.

off-hook.text: If you’d like to make a call, please hang up and try again.

ratings-1-1.text: Thank you for calling the Home Software Rating Council.

ratings-1-2.text: Your call is important to us.

ratings-1-3.text: Please hold for the next available rating specialist.

teddy-bad-key-1.text: That key leads to the biscuit cupboard.

teddy-bad-key-2.text: The cupboard has declined to comment.

teddy-bill-tail-1.text: Gwinn has offered to pay in lint.

teddy-bill-tail-2.text: The telephone company is considering it.

teddy-hint-1-1.text: Save with F5 before trying a tricky stretch.

teddy-hint-1-2.text: Use different save slots so one unfortunate landing does not become family history.

teddy-hint-1-4.text: Gwinn saves after saying, watch this.

teddy-hint-2-1.text: Open the game box and choose Level Maps.

teddy-hint-2-2.text: Follow the marked start and exits.

teddy-hint-2-3.text: Dashed wrap edges join: leaving one side can bring you back on the other.

teddy-hint-2-4.text: Teddy calls this geography with a revolving door.

teddy-hint-3-1.text: Watch an enemy before charging in.

teddy-hint-3-2.text: Look for a gap in its movement, keep an escape route, and check whether your character can shoot.

teddy-hint-3-3.text: A boss may have another stage.

teddy-hint-3-4.text: Teddy recommends waiting until the victory is actually victorious.

teddy-hint-4-1.text: The game box may include a hint book, and the walkthrough shows a route through the game.

teddy-hint-4-4.text: Paying a corgi to tell you where the free help lives is extremely 1994.

teddy-menu.text: Press 1 for saving, 2 for maps, 3 for enemies, 4 for free help, 5 for the pretend bill, or 0 to hang up.

teddy-rate-1.text: This game charges a fictional $1.99 per minute, never real money.

teddy-rate-2.text: Press 1 to start the meter, or 0 to leave free.

teddy-rate-3.text: Teddy accepts neither credit cards nor stolen sandwiches.
